decisive_items: acute, severe precordial chest pain radiating to their left arm
broad-based, asymmetrical, tall upright T waves in precordial leads V2 through V5
Subtotal occlusion of the proximal left anterior descending artery
response.rationale: Classic ACS presentation with ischemic symptoms, hyperacute T waves, and angiographic culprit lesion; normal troponin does not exclude ACS in early phase.
